description: Unit test class for HttpStatusCodeValueValidator, testing validation logic, immutability, and exception handling for HTTP status code validation.

classes.name: HttpStatusCodeValueValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the behavior of HttpStatusCodeValueValidator, including immutability and correct exception throwing for invalid inputs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the validator instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the HttpStatusCodeValueValidator class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as definition throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Ensures that accepting null as value throws DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: canValidateInteger
methods.description: Checks that the validator correctly indicates it can validate int and Integer types.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Verifies that a valid HTTP status code string is accepted without exceptions.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotInt
methods.description: Confirms that incorrect types are not validated without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: acceptNonIntCharSequence
methods.description: Tests rejecting non-integer string as an invalid HTTP status code.

methods.name: acceptNonHttpStatusCodeIntCharSequence
methods.description: Tests rejection of numeric strings that are outside the valid HTTP status code range.
